files.summary: Persisted per-routine schedule status (lastSlot/lastRunId/lastRunAt/lastResult/missedCount/overdueSlot) exposed as RoutineView.scheduleStatus {state: manual|disabled|paused|running|overdue|completed|scheduled, nextDueAt}. Slots missed while closed, skipped by overlap/safe-launch, or passed while paused are recorded as overdue (counted with the bounded countSlots) and are never run late by themselves. New engine methods: retry(runId) (new run of only the unfinished steps, same guards, fresh per-step native confirmations, seeds the previous-step condition), recover(id) (user-requested run of an overdue slot, requires the trusted start confirmation first), dismissOverdue(id), exportText(id), importPreview(text). Pure exports: exportRoutine, parseRoutineImport (64 KB cap, strict keys, <=20 steps, same step validation as the editor so only http/https/mailto links, planned action types, no click/shell/record/drag; ids, schedule and enabled flag never imported; risky steps listed as warnings), countSlots. RunRecord.retryOf added. RoutinesApi gains OPTIONAL retry/recover/dismissOverdue/exportRoutine/importPreview. RoutineData gains status (loaded defensively, old stores still load).

Overdue notices with 'Run now…' (trusted confirmation in main) and Dismiss; schedule state badge, last run/result and missed count per routine; per-routine Pause/Resume schedule via the existing lossless save (past slots never run); history filter (All / Needs attention / Scheduled), step counts, duration, retry/recovery labels, Retry unfinished steps, Cancel also for paused runs; Export (JSON text) and Import-from-file box in the editor that only fills the editor after engine validation; weekday/time conditions are now kept on edit instead of silently dropped. Every new control is hidden when the injected API lacks the optional method, so older bridges render as before.

16 tests: overdue persisted across restarts and recovered with injected clock; recovery refused when declined/no trusted confirm/safe launch; dismiss/edit/manual-run clears overdue; interval missed counting (bounded); paused and overlap-skipped slots become overdue; persisted status incl. malformed and interrupted; retry repeats only unfinished steps with fresh confirmations and guards (clean, active, paused, deleted routine, duplicate, cancelled); export/import round trip; import validation matrix (size, JSON, format, extra fields, step bounds, bad URLs, click/shell/record/drag, retries, undoable, ids ignored, warnings); condition-preserving editor and schedule pause; history helpers; screen render with and without the new API methods; source-scan for shell/fs/network/Electron/input and Date.now.

captainWiring.contractsAndIpc: To light up the new controls, add optional JarvisAPI methods and handlers: routinesRetry(runId)->api.retry, routinesRecover(id)->api.recover, routinesDismissOverdue(id)->api.dismissOverdue, routinesExport(id)->api.exportRoutine, routinesImportPreview(text: string, max 70_000 chars)->api.importPreview. Arg schemas: [ID] for the first three, [{kind:'string', max: 70000}] for import; add the five names to ROUTINE_METHODS in src/ui/bridges.ts so routinesBridge maps them (missing ones are simply omitted from the bridge and the UI hides the control). No other renderer-side change needed.
captainWiring.lifecycleHook: Call routines.fire() from Electron powerMonitor 'resume' (and 'unlock-screen') in the main owner so slots that came due during sleep are recorded as missed/overdue or run within the grace window immediately instead of waiting for the next timer tick. fire() is already idempotent per slot.
captainWiring.trustedConfirm: recover() and scheduled starts rely on the injected env.confirm (trusted dialog.showMessageBox, Cancel default). It must stay main-process; without it recovery is refused.

limitations: Per-routine pause/resume is the schedule on/off toggle (a lossless save). A running routine still pauses only through the global Pause all.
Retry re-runs unfinished steps using the routine's current definition; steps deleted since the run are ignored, and 'previous step' conditions are seeded from the original run's preceding step.
Undo remains limited to window moves marked undoable; every other action type is not reversible and is never offered for undo.
Overdue state is tracked per routine for the latest missed slot; earlier missed slots are counted (capped at 1000) but only the latest can be recovered.
Import/export is copy-paste JSON text only; there is no file picker or clipboard access in the engine. Imports never carry schedules or enable themselves.

Gates unchanged and honest: 88 (richer file/browser adapters), 89 (watch-once recording) and 90 (semantic drag) stay unavailable behind the input-injection gate; no input recording or arbitrary shell exists.
Verified with a mock native adapter, the real ActionService and stub trusted confirmations only; no real desktop action and no Electron runtime or visual check (react static-markup render only).
Not wired in this worktree: the five new bridge methods above wait for the captain.
